Graduate Admissions
College of Arts and Sciences (CAS)
Our graduates proudly go out into the world as critical thinkers and problem solvers.
American University's College of Arts and Sciences offers a world-class education that prepares students for lives of leadership and purpose. As part of an R1-designated university—recognized for the highest level of research activity—our graduate programs combine rigorous academics with real-world engagement.
Located in Washington, DC, the College provides unmatched access to leading research centers, global organizations, policymakers, and cultural institutions that connect our students directly to the industries and issues shaping our world.
With more than 50 graduate degrees and certificates across 19 departments, students pursue innovative research and applied learning across the humanities, arts, social sciences, and sciences. Our nationally known faculty are dedicated mentors who involve students in hands-on, meaningful scholarship. Learning extends into state-of-the-art facilities like the Hall of Science and Katzen Arts Center—and into the community through fieldwork, creative practice, and internships with institutions such as NASA, the Smithsonian, and the World Bank.

"In AU’s MS in Data Science Program, I had amazing opportunities that included the Data Science Summer Professional Development Program for District of Columbia Public Schools, and my Data Science practicum project, in which I worked with NASA and the GLOBE Observer Program. Working in these organizations with other young professionals was beneficial for my growth as a data scientist and building my personal network."
—Elizabeth Marge, Data Analytics Specialist, General Services Administration (GSA), US Federal Government
